Episode 5 (Original 88) story overview

Spoiler-free overview

As tension with Akkoyunlu grows, Mehmed faces pressure from both his rivals and his own court. The official Episode 88 synopsis places diplomacy and Şehzade Mustafa’s future at the centre of the next chapter.

Urdu reading summary

پانچویں قسط کا سرکاری پیش منظر سفارت کاری، دربار کے دباؤ اور شہزادہ مصطفیٰ کے مستقبل پر توجہ دیتا ہے۔ مکمل قسط کا انجام جاری ہونے کے بعد معتبر شواہد کی بنیاد پر شامل کیا جائے گا۔

Choose Urdu subtitles, not a dubbed cut

Open Season 4 Episode 5, original Episode 88, then select Urdu Subtitles on Great Nation. The original dialogue is Turkish; the Urdu text is the translation. Urdu Dubbed is a separate spoken-audio version, so its episode cuts can differ.

For released episodes, the Niazi source in the guide is the Urdu edition. If you arrive through a search for Sultan Muhammad Fateh, compare both the season episode and original broadcast number before choosing the player.

Episode 5 (Original 88): frequently asked questions

Is Season 4 Episode 5 the same as Episode 88?+

Yes. Season 4 Episode 5 maps to overall Turkish Episode 88, also written Bölüm 88. A dubbed release can use a different cut or numbering.

What is the release date for Episode 88?+

The original Turkish broadcast is scheduled for 13 October 2026. The Urdu subtitle upload time is not confirmed.

Where can I watch Episode 88 with Urdu subtitles for free?+

Great Nation is our first choice for free viewing and notifications. Episode 88 with Urdu subtitles is awaiting release.

How do I choose the correct Urdu version?+

Use overall Episode 88 or Season 4 Episode 5, and check for Urdu subtitles. A title alone does not confirm a playable subtitled release.
